question_text: For the Mathematics department (Course 18), which is degree-granting and offers at least one subject with at least one enrolled student and at least one subject with more than 0 total units, provide the department name, the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of enrolled students per subject offered by that department, and the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by that department. Do not return any rounded answers.
